1) Clean on, under, and around machine

Check the alignment of the safety light bar by doing the following:
1) Turn the machine on
2) In right side electric cabinet, turn on 24VDC breaker off
3) Press and hold the "Light Bar Align" button located left of electrical cabinet
4) Continue to hold the "Light Bar Align" button and turn the 24VDC breaker on
5) Continue to hold the "Light Bar Align" button for 5 seconds and then release the button
6) Observe the RED illuminated number on the face of the left light bar
7) The number will range from 1 to 4 (with 4 being best & 1 being worst)
8) Adjust the angle and tilt of the light bars until a reading of 4 is present
9) Turn machine off and wait 90 seconds
10) Turn machine on and run production as required
